title: Enzyme-cascade-amplified colorimetric biosensing platform for sub-nanomolar methylmercury in environmental waters
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2112-2122
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09313A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wanyan Wu, Yan Guo, Lidan Deng, Wenwu Gong, Shunyu Hu, Fen Liu, Chang-ye Hui
An enzyme-cascade-amplified whole-cell biosensor detects methylmercury in water with an LOD of 0.04 nM via indigoidine pigment production. The platform enables cost-effective, high-throughput screening for environmental monitoring.
